note: Rates are vendor-published API list prices per million tokens as read on the checked date, and are assumed to have held since each entry's effective date. The table-level source and checked date are Anthropic's pricing page and apply to every entry that carries no source/checked of its own; OpenAI and Cursor entries carry their own, plus a note recording the basis of their effective date. Claude entries: cache_write_5m / cache_write_1h are the 5-minute and 1-hour TTL write rates, cache_read is the cache-hit rate, fast_input/fast_output are fast-mode rates and are absent where fast mode is not offered. OpenAI entries: input is the standard-tier short-context (<=272K input tokens per request) list rate, cache_read is the cached-input rate, and the two cache_write fields both hold the single cache-write rate the page lists (OpenAI has no TTL split; a cache write is a category of input token billed at 1.25x input rather than an additive fee) or 0 where the page lists none. Codex rollouts record cached input as a subset of input, which the report subtracts before pricing, and record no cache writes. Long-context, batch, flex and fast tiers are not modelled: rollouts record no service tier. Cursor entries: the rate Cursor's models page states for the model, with a cache_write of 0 where that page lists none; Cursor CLI journals expose no billing counters today, so these entries price only usage a future journal records. Every figure priced from this table is an estimate at published API rates, not a subscription invoice.

rates.note: Anthropic's page publishes no availability date, so effective is the table's floor date. The cache-hit rate is the page's 0.05x-of-input figure for this model, not the usual 0.1x.
